rules.label: Up to 6 months per visit
notes: Visitors must not live in the UK through frequent or successive visits. Border officers can refuse entry even if you are under 6 months.
Many nationalities need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) before travelling.
The last safe day is calculated conservatively as 6 calendar months minus one day. Check the date on your entry record.

rules.label: Statutory Residence Test: 183 days in the tax year
notes: Only the automatic 183-day test is modelled. Under the 'sufficient ties' test you can become UK resident with as few as 16 days, depending on your ties (family, accommodation, work, 90-day and country ties).
A day counts if you are in the UK at midnight at the end of that day. Some transit and exceptional-circumstance days are excluded.
The UK tax year runs from 6 April to 5 April.
